title: Breaking Dawn
author: Stephenie Meyer
summary: The final Twilight book begins with a wedding and honeymoon, then moves into an unexpected pregnancy. It ends with the Cullens gathering allies against a threat from the vampire ruling council.
readIf: you have followed the series and want to see how Bella and Edward's story concludes.
skipIf: you have not read the earlier books, or dislike a story whose midsection turns on a dramatic, graphic birth.

pairings.reason: A much older and more adult look at the experience of being a vampire, full of philosophy and loss.
Another young adult fantasy with a heroine discovering her power and a dangerous, charismatic attraction.
A more mature fantasy romance that also puts a human woman into a world of powerful immortals.
